name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin 7% off its high; Binance withdrawals resuming after record theft
state: Bitcoin was near $80,200 on 4 Nov, about 7% below its 52-week high and far from the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Binance restored withdrawals for major coins from 1 Nov and plans to cover most of the roughly $6bn theft the FBI attributes to North Korea (CBS News). With outflows reported as normalised and no stablecoin de-peg, exchange stress no longer meets the Watch line as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Crypto holders face normal volatility. Exchange-specific risk remains after the Binance theft; regulators' consumer warnings on crypto still apply.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 7% < 25%; no top-10 exchange failing = Normal

sources.title: CBS News — Binance resumes withdrawals after $6 billion heist
AMBCrypto — Bitcoin holds near $78K as Binance withdrawals resume

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
